mapper.select: SELECT m.year AS year, ROUND(AVG(m.usage_kwh) / 1000000, 1) AS avgGwh FROM monthly_data m JOIN region r ON m.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = #{name} GROUP BY m.year ORDER BY m.year
SELECT t.year AS year, ROUND(AVG(t.total) / 1000000, 1) AS avgGwh FROM (SELECT year, month, SUM(usage_kwh) AS total FROM monthly_data GROUP BY year, month) t GROUP BY t.year ORDER BY t.year
SELECT year AS year, ROUND(AVG(usage_kwh) / 1000000, 1) AS avgGwh FROM monthly_data GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

SELECT m.year AS year, m.month AS month, ROUND(m.usage_kwh / 1000000, 1) AS usageGwh FROM monthly_data m JOIN region r ON m.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = #{name} ORDER BY m.year, m.month
SELECT year AS year, month AS month, ROUND(SUM(usage_kwh) / 1000000, 1) AS usageGwh FROM monthly_data GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month
SELECT year AS year, month AS month, ROUND(AVG(usage_kwh) / 1000000, 1) AS usageGwh FROM monthly_data GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month
